releaseNotes: v3.9.1: FireOS image pipeline hardening for Trex IPTV. Removed custom Coil MaxSizeInterceptor, forced software bitmap decoding with allowHardware(false), removed crossfade to prevent dual-bitmap OOM drops, and added User-Agent VLC/3.0.0 on network requests to avoid Trex/Cloudflare 403 image responses.
